description: Dumbbell Chart Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All features included Business analysts often need to compare two related values across categories — budget vs actual, before vs after — yet native charts make this hard when both values share an axis. Dumbbell Chart places two markers per category on a shared scale, connected by a line that makes the gap immediately visible. Key Capabilities Dual Marker Layout — Two markers per category on a shared value axis with a connecting line, in horizontal or vertical orientation. Change Labels with Indicators — Display the gap as an absolute number, percentage, or both, with optional up/down triangle indicators. Format-Aware Axes — Currency and percentage formats detected automatically from the data model for axes, labels, and tooltips. Independent Conditional Colour — Apply numeric rules or field-value colour mapping to each marker series independently Marker Shapes & Styling — Circle, Square, Diamond, or Triangle with independent size, colour, opacity, and outline per series. Small Multiples — Trellis grid with axis coupling and range matching. Reference Bands — Unlimited shaded bands with independent colour, opacity, labels, and font formatting.
